questions.questionText:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming
the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts,
decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.
Statements:
All hens are eggs.
No birds are eggs.
All eggs are lions.
Conclusions:
I. All hens are lions.
II. Some lions are hens.
III. No eggs are birds.
options: Either conclusion II or III follows.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (C).
